title.description: Short imperative title for the change, e.g. 'Add retry to GitHub sync'. Max ~80 chars.

summary.description: One or two sentences describing what the change accomplishes and why.

target_repo.description: owner/repo to change. Omit unless the request clearly names a repository; the deployment supplies the default.

target_branch.description: Suggested feature branch name, kebab-case, prefixed 'code-task/'. The cloud session opens a PR from this branch; never 'main' or 'development'.

instructions.description: Detailed, unambiguous implementation instructions for an autonomous coding agent: what to change, where, and the expected behavior. Restate the user's intent precisely; do not invent scope beyond what was asked.

acceptance_criteria.description: Concrete, checkable conditions that define done (tests pass, behavior observed, etc.).

affected_areas.description: Best-guess files, modules, or subsystems likely to change. Empty array if genuinely unknown.

open_questions.description: Ambiguities the requester should resolve. Empty array when the request is unambiguous.

confidence.description: 0..1 confidence that this spec faithfully captures an actionable, well-scoped change.
